description: SEC Form 4 insider transaction filings for a US-listed company: filing date, the officer/director/10%-owner who filed, whether the filing was made under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan (`rule_10b5_1_plan` true/false, null when the filing predates the April 2023 checkbox; plus the plan adoption date and footnote text when stated), and a link to the filing on EDGAR. Answers who at a company has been buying or selling its stock recently. Ticker or company name is resolved to a CIK, so results are that issuer's filings. Response field matched_by says whether the company was matched by ticker or by company name.

plan_flags.description: How many of the newest filings to read for the Rule 10b5-1 plan flag (one SEC request each; default 5, max 25, 0 to skip). Older rows carry plan_flag_status "not_fetched".

ticker.description: Stock ticker ("AAPL", "NVDA"), company name ("NVIDIA Corp"), or CIK

name: insider_trades

cik.description: SEC CIK the ticker resolved to (unpadded)

plan_adoption_date.description: Plan adoption date (YYYY-MM-DD) parsed from the filer's footnote, when stated

plan_flag_status.description: read = flag taken from the filing; predates_field = filing has no checkbox; unavailable = document could not be read; not_fetched = beyond the plan_flags window

plan_footnotes.description: Footnote texts in the filing that mention Rule 10b5-1

rule_10b5_1_plan.description: Rule 10b5-1 trading-plan checkbox on the Form 4: true = ticked, false = explicitly unticked, null = filing predates the field (before April 2023), not fetched or unreadable; see plan_flag_status

matched_by.description: How the company was matched: ticker, cik or company_name

matched_form4_filings.description: Number of Form 4 filings matching upstream for this company and window, which may exceed the number returned

total_form4_filings.description: Number of Form 4 filings RETURNED in `filings`, always equals filings.length

truncated.description: True when more filings matched upstream than were returned; raise `limit` to see them

title: Insider Trades
